correctness.rationale: Using character dual grid z_i^N=1, the Fourier polynomial for a symmetrized optimizer is F_t(z)=1+t(|sum_i z_i|²-4). Exact minimal root-sum radius is r=0 for even N, 2(1-cos(π/N)) for odd N, yielding masses 4 or 1+3/(c(2-c)). The odd equality contacts are twelve permutations of (1,1,-c+is,-c-is); independent symbolic six-by-six real/imaginary contact determinants reproduced -64 c³(c-2)(c-1)³(c+1)^5 and -64(c-1)³(c+1)³, nonzero for odd N>=5. At even N zero-sum character contacts enforce three complementary real-edge-sum equations and imaginary gradient potentials modulo constants; nonzero Fourier slack gives full six-real-dimensional relative face. Independent direct four-root enumeration N5..12 reproduced the sharp minimum; the package checker was inspected for separate Fourier-contact tests. The quartic expansion is 3π^4/(4N^4)+O(N^-6) along odd N. Enumeration does not prove all N; the 4-root geometry and contact-rank argument do.
